features.name: 10 paylines
features.description: A classic 5x3 layout with gems and sevens.

features.name: Stacked wilds

features.name: Wild duplication
features.description: Stacked wilds on bonus reels are copied to the following reels.

review:
A simple 10-line classic with gems, bells, stars and sevens. The features are Lucky Spins and stacked wilds.

The fun bit: in the bonus, a stacked wild on reel 3 gets copied onto the reels after it, so the screen can fill with wilds very quickly. Medium-high volatility with a 2,500x max. The 94.03% RTP is on the low side, so it's best for short, casual demo sessions.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
